title: A fundamental flaw leaves LLMs strikingly vulnerable to attack
content: It is impossible to make large language models fully secure against hacks because of a fundamental flaw in how they work, a team of researchers argue in a paper presented at the International Conference on Machine Learning, a top AI conference, this month. The claim has huge implications for the safety of this technology, which…
author: Will Douglas Heaven
summary_zh: 研究者在ICML会议上提出，LLM的工作原理存在根本性缺陷，导致其无法被完全防御攻击（如提示注入）。这对依赖LLM构建的编程工具和自动化工作流的安全性有重要警示意义，提醒开发者在设计Agent系统时必须假设模型层面无法彻底免疫攻击。

title: PPDL: LLM-Based Flows as Probabilistic Programs
content:
arXiv:2608.05234v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Building reliable applications that leverage large language models (LLMs) remains a significant challenge. While LLMs offer impressive capabilities across diverse tasks, their outputs often lack accuracy and provide no clear measure of confidence. This uncertainty compounds in flows of multiple calls to LLMs and other tools, making it difficult for developers and end-users to trust the results. This paper introduces a probabilistic language for programming LLM-based flows. It enables developers to quantify and propagate uncertainty throughout the application's flow, and experiment with different inference scaling techniques without adding a single line of code beyond the flow's logic. We present an experimental study to demonstrate this capability, and a case study building a theorem proving agent for the Rocq theorem prover.
author: Louis Mandel, Guillaume Baudart, Mandana Vaziri, Martin Hirzel
summary_zh: 本文提出PPDL，一种将LLM调用流建模为概率程序的编程语言，可在多步LLM工作流中量化并传播不确定性。开发者无需额外代码即可尝试不同的推理扩展（inference scaling）技术，提升LLM应用的可靠性与可信度。对构建多步LLM pipeline的工程实践有参考价值。

title: Add ito-inference and ito-training skills (delegate to canonical Itô …
content:
Add ito-inference and ito-training skills (delegate to canonical Itô backend) (#2700)

Two ECC skills chaining off an ito-compute booking, per the Full-Stack Harness
Engineering Plan (2026-08-06):

- ito-inference: serve a model on booked GPUs via ecc ito serve (Layer 0.2).
- ito-training: run a staged, eval-gated training pipeline via ecc ito train
  (Layer 0.3).

Both match the existing ito-compute skill: origin ECC, delegate to the canonical
CLI/backend, implement no parallel serving/training stack, chain off a completed
booking, and never book, reserve, or spend. They report the missing capability
while the desk serve-on-booking / training-run backends are scaffolds.

Co-authored-by: Affaan Mustafa <affaan@itomarkets.com>
author: alejandorosumah-mansa
summary_zh: 该 commit 为 everything-claude-code 仓库新增 ito-inference 和 ito-training 两个技能，分别用于在已预订的 GPU 上部署模型推理和运行分阶段、评估门控的训练流水线。两者均遵循「委托给规范后端 CLI、不自建并行技术栈、链式依赖已完成预订、绝不擅自消费资源」的技能设计原则，展示了 Claude Code 技能间职责边界与链式组合的工程实践。

title: fix(skills): default GAN harness models to sonnet (#2442) (#2695)
content:
fix(skills): default GAN harness models to sonnet (#2442) (#2695)

Completes the model re-tiering from #2442: the gan-planner, gan-generator,
and gan-evaluator agents were already re-pinned to sonnet, but the
gan-style-harness script and docs still defaulted GAN_PLANNER_MODEL,
GAN_GENERATOR_MODEL, and GAN_EVALUATOR_MODEL to opus. Align the script
defaults, skill docs (en/ja/zh), and example commands with the landed
agent tiers. Opus remains available via the existing env overrides.
